rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Affectionate Resentment
card.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your favourite, too. I'll warm your plate; I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

card.title: Affectionate Resentment
card.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've warmed your side of the bed, love. You sounded frozen waiting for that taxi.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. Here's another blanket. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting forty minutes.

card.title: Relationship Ledger
card.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It is. I'd like to hand it over beside my paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hanging buys forgiveness. Stay to take them down and I'll stop mentioning the argument to Mum.

card.title: Relationship Ledger
card.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to collect my things. I work Sundays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Saturday lunch buys the hallway. Your records are in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring lunch for both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That gets you the records. Stay to listen to one with me and I'll help carry the boxes.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's happened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I read it aloud?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep hold of the page too. I'll follow your finger. No need to ask why I'm taking so long.

card.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
card.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay for tea. I need to tell the children about tomorrow's operation without crying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've had three cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then skip the kettle. Let me practise telling you before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My taxi's outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me say 'I'll be in hospital' without apologising to you. Then I'll try telling them myself.

card.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
card.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave me in the new flat, count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. Five more while I look at the empty kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.

card.title: Understand the Hurt
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I saved you a front-row seat at my concert. Do you understand why it hurt?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you work might run late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I knew. I still looked at that empty seat before every song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You needed someone there who knew what this meant to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You'd heard me practise for months. Please tell me you understand why someone else couldn't fill it.

card.title: Understand the Hurt
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I texted that I'd lost my job. Your silence hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My phone died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I thought our conversation had. I deleted the message before you replied.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You thought I'd stopped caring? I was charging it so I could call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believe you. But can you see why I deleted it? I felt like asking you to care was another application I'd failed.

card.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
card.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I only finished one painting for our exhibition. Tell me I've done enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice the gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need to know I've contributed, not that you can hide where I haven't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce me as the other painter. No 'despite everything'. I want to hear that I belong here.

card.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
card.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I made it through the speech without leaving. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You forgot a paragraph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I'm asking about staying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stayed all the way through. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could staying earn me tomorrow off? Tell me I can put the speech away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please make the cancellation call while I recover from my excellent demonstration of endurance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can say you're overwhelmed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can say the champion requires one call less.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you like me to stay afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As a fellow professional admiring the recovery, yes. Bring two cups.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A accepts practical support only as recognition of endurance; the request for shared emotional weight is embedded in resisting pity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read this letter beside me, but keep the sympathetic face for someone less formidable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A formidable amount of anticipation. Start the first line for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can take it slowly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Frame that as a strategic pace, not a rescue.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A accepts practical support only as recognition of endurance; the request for shared emotional weight is embedded in resisting pity.

card.title: Don’t Pity Me
card.instruction: Frame your struggle as evidence of strength, steering concern toward admiration and rejecting anything that feels like pity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You came to my solo show. Please stop saying 'brave' in that sad voice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Three people walked out. I wanted to buy you a drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I finished anyway. You can buy a drink for that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll invite the cast next door. They're celebrating a sellout.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Tell them I finished with no audience at all. Let's see them do that.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you make this one call for me? Just say the booking's cancelled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's wrong?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you want to talk afterward?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. One thing lighter might make room.

card.title: Don’t Pity Me
card.instruction: Frame your struggle as evidence of strength, steering concern toward admiration and rejecting anything that feels like pity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I carried the entire move myself. Please stop making that poor-you face.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You must be exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Impressively exhausted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I bring you tea?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. In the mug marked champion, not survivor.

card.title: Let Me Lean
card.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I read it aloud?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want me beside you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Let's call that helping with the lighting.
